lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness, a visitor! Perhaps you can help me. I've gone and lost my books.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Three of them, I'm certain. I had them with me just this morning.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I must have set them down somewhere on my walk around the camp. Could you find them for me?

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: They'll be spinning about in the open, you can't miss them. Bring them back and I'll be forever grateful!

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Any luck finding my books? There should be three of them, scattered around the camp.

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Keep looking. I'm sure they can't have gone far!

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: You found them! All three of them! I can't believe it.

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: Well done, my friend. You've made an old man very happy today.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thank you again for finding my books. I've kept them close ever since!
